sampling: Ten distinct test conversations sampled without replacement from conversations with 4–12 matched turns. All English→Chinese, following dataset provenance. Full dialogues retained, no turn truncation.
formatting: Split at __eou__; trim surrounding whitespace; prefix each unchanged turn with [Turn N]. No invented speaker identities.
